name: Whirlwind Strike
body:
School divination; Level inquisitor 4, lathspell 3, legendary ninja 3, ranger 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components S, F (a melee weapon you are wielding)

EFFECT

Range personal
Target self
Duration 1 round

DESCRIPTION

With a flourish you channel the swiftness of the wind into your blade. After casting this spell you make a single attack at your highest base attack bonus against each enemy within reach. If you move after casting this spell you do not provoke attacks of opportunity from any creature hit by one of these attacks.
